title: Placement: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
description: Given an array of integers `heights` representing the histogram's bar height where the width of each bar is 1, return the area of the largest rectangle in the histogram.
solution:
def largest_rectangle_area(heights: list[int]) -> int:
    stack = []
    max_area = 0
    h = heights + [0]
    for i, val in enumerate(h):
        while stack and h[stack[-1]] > val:
            height = h[stack.pop()]
            width = i if not stack else i - stack[-1] - 1
            max_area = max(max_area, height * width)
        stack.append(i)
    return max_area
explanation: A monotonic increasing stack tracks indices. When a shorter bar is encountered, rectangles bounded by popped heights are calculated in linear O(N) time.
